backfill.activity: Building the activity map from your forum's history: {percent}%
backfill.streaks: Building streaks from your members' history: {percent}%
backfill.help: This runs in the background — on the queue if you have one, otherwise every minute from the scheduler, and while this page is open. Members' flames appear as they are built. On a big forum you can also run php flarum cadence:rebuild-streaks to watch it finish.

streak.heading: Streaks
streak.enabled_help: The switch for the whole streaks feature: flames, the header button, the Streaks link and leaderboard, the profile tab, widgets, alerts and emails. Turn it off to use Cadence only for the activity map; nothing is counted while it is off, and nothing is deleted.
streak.off_notice: Streaks are off. Nothing about them appears anywhere on the forum, and the activity map below works on its own. Turn Daily streaks on and save to set them up.
streak.mode_help: Contributing (posting, replying, liking or reacting) can be rebuilt from your forum's history. Visiting rewards people who just read, but there is no history of visits, so those days start counting from now.
streak.streak_grace_help: Missed days in a row that are forgiven without using a freeze (0 to 3).
streak.streak_milestones_help: Lengths in days that are celebrated and earn freezes, separated by commas.
streak.streak_freeze_per_milestone_help: How many freezes each milestone earns.
streak.streak_freeze_bank_help: The most freezes a member can hold at once.
streak.streak_embers_min_help: The shortest flame that leaves embers when it goes out. 0 turns revival off.
streak.streak_embers_hours_help: How long a member has to post and revive a flame that went out.
streak.streak_embers_share_help: The share of the old flame a revival restores.
streak.streak_hall_min_help: The shortest run that is remembered in the Hall of Flames when it ends.
streak.streak_risk_min_help: The shortest flame whose owner gets an "at risk" alert and email.
streak.streak_risk_hour_help: The hour of the member's own day, 0 to 23, after which an unfed flame is at risk.
streak.streak_bonfire_levels_help: Flames fed in a day to reach each bonfire level, separated by commas.
streak.streak_timezone_help: Used for members whose browser has not told the forum theirs yet, e.g. Europe/London. Everyone else's day follows their own timezone.
streak.in_header_help: Beside notifications, with the streak, the next tier and the month one tap away.
streak.on_posts: A flame after names in posts
streak.on_posts_help: Costs no requests; the flame rides along with the author.
streak.on_cards: A streak line on user cards
streak.on_profile_help: The member's flame, a year of fed days, the month and (to them) their journal.
streak.nav_help: A link to the leaderboard under All Discussions.
streak.sidebar: Streak blocks in the index sidebar
streak.sidebar_help: My flame and Top flames, for forums without a widget manager. With fof/forum-widgets-core or Bespoke, place the widgets there instead.

tiers.title: Flame tiers
tiers.help: The flame changes colour and icon as a streak grows. The highest enabled tier a member's streak reaches is theirs. Leave a name empty to use the translated default.
tiers.name: Name

seasons.title: Seasonal flames
seasons.help: Between two dates (MM-DD, may wrap the new year) every flame takes the season's colour and icon. Birthdays from Calendar get a golden flame.

overview.title: Overview
overview.from_days: from {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}

sheet.title: Member flame sheet
sheet.help: Find a member to give freezes, set their streak, revive the last flame that went out, or reset it. Every change is written to their journal with your name.
sheet.reset_confirm: Put this member's flame out? This cannot be undone.

admin.show_on_profile: Show the map on member profiles
admin.show_on_profile_help: The full map, on every profile. This is the one most forums want.
admin.show_on_posts: Show a sparkline beside every post
admin.show_on_posts_help: A small twenty-six week trace next to each author. Costs one extra query per distinct member on a page — not per post — so it is cheap, but it is off unless you ask for it.
admin.show_on_cards: Show a sparkline on user cards
admin.show_on_cards_help: On hover cards and anywhere else a member is summarised.
